question: In what year did Curiosity launch?

units.text: Part of NASA's Mars Science Laboratory mission, at the time of launch Curiosity was the largest and most capable rover ever sent to Mars.
Early in its mission, Curiosity's scientific tools found chemical and mineral evidence of past habitable environments on Mars.

Curiosity was the largest and most capable rover ever sent to Mars when it launched in 2011. Curiosity set out to answer the question: Did Mars ever have the right environmental conditions to support small life forms called microbes?
It continues to explore the rock record from a time when Mars could have been home to microbial life.
